## zarf package inspect signature

Displays signature information for the specified package

### Synopsis

Displays cryptographic signature metadata (such as signing method, certificate identity, and OIDC issuer) from a signed package bundle without decompressing or downloading the entire package.

```
zarf package inspect signature [ PACKAGE_SOURCE ] [flags]
```

### Examples

```

# Inspect signature of a local package tarball
$ zarf package inspect signature zarf-package-my-app-amd64-1.0.0.tar.zst

# Inspect signature of a package in an OCI registry (oci:// prefix optional)
$ zarf package inspect signature oci://ghcr.io/my-org/my-package:1.0.0

# Output the raw signature or Sigstore bundle
$ zarf package inspect signature zarf-package-my-app-amd64-1.0.0.tar.zst --raw

```

### Options

```
  -h, --help                  help for signature
      --oci-concurrency int   Number of concurrent layer operations for OCI pulls (default 6)
      --raw                   Output the raw signature or Sigstore bundle content
```
